title: Pixel Sprites in Lit 3D — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Walk through the lit street
scenes.purpose: Establish the pixel actor in layered 3D depth: projected shadow, foreground occlusion and parallax.
visuals: Moonlit stone street, brick back wall with a dim circuit panel, far skyline
Overhead beam casting a shadow band across the floor
Warm street lamp on the right
Title card top-left on a solid dark panel

beats.development: Title card slides in (settled by 0.32s); the sprite starts walking and passes through the beam's projected shadow band around 0.37s, darkening as it crosses.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

beats.development: The camera trucks right with the walk; the sprite passes behind the foreground pillar (fully hidden for about 0.3s near 1.0s) and comes back out.
The sprite slows into the warm lamp pool, shifting from cool to warm shading, and stops.

scenes.title: The idea connects the system
scenes.purpose: Turn the stop under the practical light into the subject: an idea becomes a connected system.
visuals: Pixel light-bulb pops above its head
Yellow pixel packet flies to the wall panel
Cyan network traces and nodes light in sequence

beats.development: Lamp brightens; sprite switches to a look-up pose; a pixel bulb pops in stepped scale and sends a spark to the panel.
Traces grow node to node from where the spark lands until all six nodes are lit.
Settled hold: lit network, sprite under the warm lamp, title readable.

findings: Walk is brisk (about 4 units/s) to fit the shadow pass, pillar occlusion and lamp stop into 1.95s.
Network connection resolves by 2.66s, before the 2.7s settle limit.
justifiedHolds: 0.3s full pillar occlusion so depth reads
Final 0.34s hold on the connected system

notes: No preview recipes listed in STYLE.json; the catalogue's characteristic action is demonstrated.
All animated values come from one GSAP timeline; the WebGL frame is redrawn from that state on every seek and on hf-seek.
